titi 

```{=html}
<div id="outputDiv" class="special-text" style="padding: 20px; border: 1px solid #ccc;">
  <p>This is raw HTML that will be rendered directly by the browser.</p>
```

toto 

```{ojs}
//| echo: false

// 1. Create the input
viewof myInput = Inputs.text({label: "Enter text:"})

// 2. Define a side-effect to mount it to the existing div
{
  const target = document.getElementById("outputDiv");
  // Clear the placeholder
  target.innerHTML = "";
  // Append the viewof DOM element
  target.appendChild(viewof myInput);
}
```
